byte_domains: DISPLAY operand concatenation + newline; ACCEPT field move bytes
damage_if_overclaimed: assuming DISPLAY separates operands (it does not) or that ACCEPT preserves an over-length line (it truncates) corrupts emitted/captured text in a ported program
lie_prevented: DISPLAY is not just a print -- it CONCATENATES operands with NO separator and adds exactly one newline; ACCEPT MOVEs the line (pad/truncate) not a free read; and DISPLAY of a SIGNED numeric reformats (+/- prefix), which is a non-claim here
negative_claims: DISPLAY of signed numeric (GnuCOBOL prefixes +/-) or V-scaled/edited numeric (reformats)
